//regions: Tokyo. Unset, Vercel defaults to iad1 (Washington DC) while the database sits in ap-northeast-1 and the users are in Japan — so every server-rendered page paid a trans-Pacific round trip PER QUERY, and pages run several. Co-locating the functions with the database turns each of those from ~150ms into ~5ms; it is the single largest thing separating a click from its result here.
